contributions.statement: A deterministic CI check that extracts class names, packages and paths from AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md and verifies they exist at HEAD catches stale references cheaply, but expect only about 1.3% of references to be stale and about a third of flags to be false, so run it as hygiene, not as a correctness gate.
contributions.evidence: §3.3 Tables 1 and 3: 230 stale of 18,048 verified references (1.27%); 82/356 repos flagged but 32/50 inspected flags genuine (64%, one annotator); median one stale reference per affected repo. Audit downgrades prevalence to weak. Impact on agents not measured (RQ3 open).

reason: 'Context rot' is documentation drift applied to agent config files; the measured per-reference stale rate is low and impact on agents is left as future work.
